title: Go-to-market and release coordination for Private Access Controls, Telemetry & Key Management
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinate the cross-functional go-to-market for three interdependent Private deployment features: role-based access control templates (RBAC), configurable audit log retention/streams, and customer-managed key (KMS) integrations. This ticket covers release notes coordination, partner enablement materials, staged customer rollouts (canary cohorts), support runbooks, and compliance evidence kits so customers can adopt in regulated environments with clear migration guidance.
background: Demand from enterprise pilot customers and legal/compliance requests drove prioritization. Engineering has delivered core APIs for RBAC roles and bindings, an audit log export endpoint with retention policy hooks, and a KMS connector that supports AWS KMS and Azure Key Vault. We must sequence messaging, docs, and training to reduce support load and avoid churn during first 30 days post-launch.
objectives: Ship cohesive release notes and KB articles that explain trade-offs and migration steps
Provide a customer-facing activation playbook and internal runbook for support/solutions
Execute a staged rollout with canary cohort and rollback triggers tied to telemetry
Ensure compliance artifacts (architecture diagrams, data flow, PKI/KMS flow) are available for security reviews
tasks: Finalize release notes draft and obtain legal/compliance sign-off
Create migration guide: existing tokens -> KMS-wrapped keys, RBAC mappings for common roles
Build sample Terraform/CloudFormation module for KMS + VPC wiring
Author support runbook with triage decision tree and escalation matrix
Prepare enablement slide deck, 45-minute webinar script, and recording
Coordinate with Console team to surface feature toggles and per-account defaults
Set up canary cohort (5 pilot customers) and expected telemetry dashboards
Confirm SLA language and update contracts team with optional encryption addendum
acceptance_criteria: Release notes approved by Product, Legal, and Security
KB migration guide published in docs.redwood.com and linked in Console
Support runbook validated by L2 on-call and Solutions Eng during dry-run
Canary telemetry dashboards show no regressions on latency/error for 72h
KMS integration validated for key rotation and zero-downtime rewrap
RBAC role templates included in Console and sample scripts

notes_for_release_notes: Private deployments: New account-level access control templates to simplify common enterprise roles (Admin, Reader, Ops).
Audit logs: Configurable retention and export streams to S3/OCI with optional real-time forwarding to SIEMs.
KMS integrations: Support for customer-managed keys (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) including automated rotation and key aliasing.
Migration: A migration guide and sample IaC modules are available to reduce friction during adoption.
post_launch_checklist: Monitor canary and GA cohorts for 14 days for latency, errors, and unauthorized-access alerts
Collect customer feedback and capture top-5 migration issues
Schedule retro with Eng/Security/Support and document action items
Confirm contract addendum uptake and track revenue motions for encryption add-on
support_triage_snippets: If customer reports missing role assignments: verify RBAC bindings and check active role templates in Console.
If audit logs not appearing: confirm retention policy, export target credentials, and network egress rules.
If KMS failures: check key policy, principal permissions, and test rewrap endpoint logs
